rules: File-level provenance of every image the v6.3 landscape page can draw (SPEC §12, survey_assets §5, assets/PROVENANCE.txt, assets/v6/PROVENANCE_v6.md). 'block' = the URL patterns blocked in the provenance run (CDP Network.setBlockedURLs), so the page falls back to its own drawing. A layer whose pixels change between the full and the blocked run contains blocked pixels: the full layer goes to MenuV6Local/, the blocked-run layer is its tracked fallback (BUILD_PLAN D7). First match wins in 'files'.
decisions: Ground truth = the live v6.3 deck page: the 6 approved deck stills (v63_deck_01..05, v63_portrait_04) re-render bit-exact through the exporter (check/E7_p4.json), so every part, rect and timeline is read from those pages

The hall ships as the approved bake without its House of Life niches (hall/room) + one niche sprite per visible grid cell (unover of the page's own niche; a scrolled row >= 2 reuses row 1's): the collection scrolls, so its niches travel with the cards; for a solved non-16:9 hall: wall + slab9 + well9 + plinth9 + border (the bake's parts, unover)

The Scale of Ma'at is a rig of the page's own 1x canvas ops (white x the mixed colour, ink first); the tilting parts are also baked at the rest tilts -.2 / +.2 so every rest state is the page's raster (max 2); over 60 the beam tilts +.2 (decided: the mirror of the approved short-of-40 tilt) and the status reads MAIN OVER 60 in the MAIN NEEDS 40 style (decided)

Text stays live (Legacy Text + TextFx, D2); glyphs the faces lack (‹ ▾ ✕ +) ship as sprites; CLEAR ALL ships as one sprite (icons/clr: its fixed text + the underline 4 px below, as drawn: Legacy Text has no underline)

Card names (collection, DRAW 5): the page's .cc .nm type (.nm.lg over 23 characters); where the page clips a long name (portrait DRAW 5: Mystical Knight of Jackal) Unity shrinks it to fit (floor = the .lg size), then ellipsis (decided)

Portrait badges cc_lm / cc_unowned_own: their first instances sit on the collection's row 2 at the stage's bottom edge and were shot cut in half (attempt 1); attempt 2 lifts that card into the stage for the shot (chrome.<n>.fit): whole units, every other shot byte-identical

The box: the golden-box D70 (land) / D88 (port) set is licence-unknown -> MenuV6Local/Box/<Lay>/ (D7); the tracked fallback = the page's own v5 box rig (the provenance run) at idle / closed / sealed; the cards in the box are the deck's own
The tab key (TOME) and the DRAW 5 torc icons are the Forbidden Memories item art when it loads (RIP) -> MenuV6Local/Deck/<Lay>/icons/, the page's own drawings tracked as their fallbacks

DRAW 5 has no mockup page: composed from the deck page's own sheet (.insp chrome + its Puzzle-lock at the inspect rect), the .tabs2 header type (DRAW 5 + FIVE AT RANDOM FROM MAIN · NOT SAVED), five cards in the House of Life frame at the collection card size, one .acts plate (DRAW AGAIN); nothing persisted (D13)

D13 kept: the inspect sheet shows the TEXT tab only (RULINGS / PRINTS tabs and BINDER hidden: no source); BuildPool stays owned-only (no catalogue browsing); the unowned veil = the existing home-only veil (the page's grayscale(1) brightness(.55) recorded, not a new filter); the ERA chip = ErazFormat.InPool per card; the +1 plate's label follows RouteAdd (+1 MAIN / EXTRA / SIDE); DRAW 5 is UI-only (a random 5 of st.Main, nothing saved); the counts / names are real data in Unity; the mockup sample deck is research-only (geo consts / sample)

Found in the page and exported as drawn: the landing slot glow and the flying card's eased glow are overridden by anime_v6.css !important rules (no slot glow; a constant fly glow); the odometer rolls 72 px in both layouts
Portrait: the search band has no FILTER / SORT buttons (deck.html hides them); they live in the thumb band

Portrait: the page's search band (y 1300) overlaps the EXTRA / SIDE row (y 1206, 95.9 tall) by 1.9 px and hides the dashed SIDE bottoms; the Unity portrait solve keeps the row above the band (no overlap; decided)
The crack nets are P2's (installed, identical to this session); this set adds the labelled DOM keep-outs for R8
